Messages.Author: David Cherryholmes
Messages.Body:
I've been wanting to do Muaziz gets the Eye for a while. I'm really only
posting it because I like the title. I just built it and am on my way out
to play it against the weenie dominate hoar-- I mean, my friends.

I've got five little nerds and a nice chunk of goddamn deflection,
Lord, please let me not die in thirty minutes.

Deck Name: Vecna's back, and She's pissed
Created By: David Cherryholmes
Description: Muaziz flanked by weenie 2/3 Tremere. Muaziz equips with Eye
of Hazimel, Hand of Conrad, Ankara Citadel, and/or Sengir Dagger. Runs
POT/THA combat. Several skill cards allow the chance to eat your way up
the food chain and past heavy Obedience users; the skill cards take the
deck past eighty cards, but in a less than linear way.

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 11, Max: 28, Avg: 4.92)
----------------------------------------------
4 Muaziz aus dom for THA 7, Tremere
1 Eugenio Estevez AUS dom for THA 6, Tremere
1 Kyoko Shinsegawa aus cel dom for 5, Tremere
1 Aisling Sturbridge AUS dom THA 5, Tremere
1 Pieter van Dorn dom pre tha 4, Tremere
1 Masika St. John THA 3, Tremere
1 Blythe Candeleria aus THA 3, Tremere
1 Ehrich Weiss dom tha 3, Tremere
1 Mustafa Rahman dom 2, Tremere

Library: (85 cards)
-------------------
Master (10 cards)
1 Arcane Library
3 Blood Doll
1 Chantry
1 Dominate
1 Fame
1 Fortitude
2 Potence

Action (11 cards)
2 Govern the Unaligned
3 Graverobbing
4 Magic of the Smith
2 Rutor's Hand

Action Modifier (6 cards)
6 Freak Drive

Reaction (6 cards)
6 Deflection

Combat (46 cards)
3 Amaranth
8 Apportation
8 Blood Fury
6 Immortal Grapple
3 Pulled Fangs
4 Skin of Steel
8 Taste of Vitae
6 Torn Signpost

Equipment (6 cards)
1 Ankara Citadel, Turkey, The
1 Eye of Hazimel
1 Flak Jacket
1 Hand of Conrad
1 IR Goggles
1 Sengir Dagger

This deck was last saved at 8:31:45 AM on 3/8/2003

David Cherryholmes
Prince of Durham, NC

Messages.Author: David Cherryholmes
Messages.Body:
On 12 Mar 2003, Xian wrote:

> Nothing like the South. ;)

Well, I think it has more to do with a certain someone's getting their
lunch money stolen a few too many times than with geography, but joke
noted.

> I know, I know. I was mostly just joking...offering my expected
> commentary. My point was really that Group 1 has more dominate.

Oh, right. Xian. Cardano. Duh.

> Sketchy, since he only has dom. I'd be more inclined to pick Marlene,
> the Infernalist, if you're not too wedded to playing all Tremere.

Not wedded to the Tremere, except that it's a Muaziz deck. I don't think
I own a Marlene, though. Isn't she Sabbat only? I have ass for Sabbat
cards.

> Hey, I was trying to give hints as to what to drop as well. :) I
> think Dreams would still be a good addition, though. Hand cycling if
> you need it, otherwise, free pool (+ transfers).

Yeah, saying "I don't have room for Dreams" is probably logically empty,
if you dig deep enough. Luckily, I transcended logic a long time ago and
am now free to ignore it at will.

> 10 master cards just seemed like "not quite enough." Vast Wealth
> would be okay, but I'm not sure I'd recommend it in place of something
> else.

Oh it isn't, not by a long shot, especially since four of them are
"phantom". Still, I have to weigh that against the fact that I'm already
five cards over my target.

> Nah. I'm trying to turn into one of those 80 card people, but it's
> not working very well.

What isn't working? If you're getting decked, then it may be
playstyle-related. If you go combat-wombat, then those are the times I
think about going to ninety. I mean, I *know* they should be ninety, but
I've built so many decks at eighty now that I default to them in my head.

> I don't know how you can get around just bleeding for two with a lot
> of Deflection in reserve. And I'd think you'd need more Deflection
> for that strategy.

Can't afford to jam up on the Deflections myself, and I don't really
intend to oust by bounce. The bounce is there to have a shot at one in my
opening hand, or a few cards after, so I get to play a game with thirty
pool to spend, instead of the 18 I usually have left by the time I get
something going.

> Hah! Quite the change.

Being sarcastic again, I assume? If not, then I think they are very much
the same. The stealth's lighter, but it includes FoM, and blocking is no
longer a no-brainer since he has a hefty amount of Claws and at least some
Kiss of Ra (seems to always have it, but that could just be appearances).

> Man, how would Lazvernius + Eternal Vigilance do in your group? Or
> did you try that recently? Seems like it'd be a pretty sweet way to
> knock down the weenies. Or maybe !Toreador + Art of Pain. Gargoyles
> + Armor of Terra + Atonement + Freak Drive?

I may pick Laz back up again. For a while, he was 'claimed' by another
player who liked him a lot, so I just avoided decks with him in them (same
as I avoid Lasombra in general just because one of our players is nuts for
them and plays several different ones regularly). I am thinking about
deliberately contesting the low cap Malkavians, just because this is
starting to affect my desire to play the game, but I haven't thought of a
deck built around them that: A) amuses me and B) isn't a clone of one of
the other "uber efficient" weenie decks these guys crank out.
